description: Unit tests for exception handler nesting behavior in breakpad's Windows client, including callback filtering and handling nested exception handlers.

methods.name: DoesPathExist
methods.description: Checks if a given file path exists by retrieving file attributes.

methods.name: CrashHandlerFilter
methods.description: Template callback function to filter exception handling based on a boolean template parameter.

methods.name: MinidumpWrittenCallback
methods.description: Template callback function invoked after minidump is written, checks if dump path exists and callback should succeed.

methods.name: DoCrash
methods.description: Function that intentionally crashes the program to trigger exception handling.

methods.name: InstallExceptionHandlerAndCrash
methods.description: Sets up an exception handler with specified filter and callback behaviors, then crashes to test.
